describe.description: A quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, with a long tapered snout, small dark eye, stout muscular limbs ending in clawed feet, and a long thick tapering tail that extends out of frame to the left. The dorsal and lateral surfaces of the body, tail, upper legs, and crown of the head are covered in overlapping rounded keratinous scales in dark to medium brown with tan edges, interspersed with patches of larger pale pink scales with fine dark speckling on the mid-back, flank, and shoulder. The skin of the snout, face, lower neck, and lower legs is light tan to gray-brown and wrinkled with fine whiskers around the muzzle. Six bright pink fleshy external gills with fine feathery filaments protrude from the neck region behind the head.

describe.description: A stocky quadrupedal animal shown in right-side profile walking to the right with its back highly arched. The body, top of the head, upper legs and long tapering tail are covered in overlapping rounded brown scales interspersed with patches of pale pink speckled scales on the flanks and shoulders. The head is elongated to a pointed blunt snout with a dark nostril at the tip, textured tan-brown skin, a small round black eye, and a dark rounded ear opening. Protruding from the side of the neck behind the head and from the top of the head are fleshy pink stalks bearing fine feathery red filaments. It stands on four short sturdy wrinkled legs ending in broad feet with long curved tan claws, and a thick scaly tail extends to the left and is partially cropped.
